Tom seems very happy.
Tom seems to be very happy.
Tom seems really happy.

original: あなたからメッセージをもらえてとても嬉しいです。

en.text: We are very happy to have received a message from you.

original: 私たちはあなたからメッセージを頂けてとても嬉しいです。

en.text: We are very happy to have received a message from you.

en.text: Tom looks happy today.

en.text: I'm glad you like our house.

en.text: I'm glad that the thief was caught.
I'm glad the thief was caught.

en.text: Tom smiled back happily.

en.text: Were you happy at that time?

en.text: When the dog is happy it wags its tail.

en.text: I'm so happy right now.

original: 彼女は夢が実現したので嬉しかった。

en.text: She was happy because her dream came true.

original: それって、すごく嬉しい。

en.text: That makes me very happy.

original: 最後にトムを見かけた時、トムは嬉しそうだった。

en.text: She's extremely happy.

original: これって、すごく嬉しい。

en.text: This makes me very happy.

original: 「お父さん、プレゼントもらってすごい嬉しそうだったね」「うん、喜んでもらえてほんとに良かったね！」

en.text: "Dad seemed to be really pleased by the gift!" "Yes, it's really nice that we could make him happy!"

original: このお店が僕らの近くにあって嬉しいな。

en.text: I'm glad this shop is close to us.

original: ここで会えるなんて、嬉しい。

en.text: I'm glad to see you here.

original: あなたに会えて嬉しいです。

original: トムが元気そうで嬉しいよ。

en.text: "Why are you smiling?" "Because I'm happy."

original: ドイツに行った友達からお土産にハリボーグミの新作をもらっちゃった。嬉しい。

en.text: I am overjoyed that my friend who visited Germany brought me some newly released Haribo.

original: 日本語を勉強して嬉しかったのは、字幕なしでドラマが見られるようになったことだ。

en.text: Being able to watch a drama without subtitles made me very glad I studied Japanese.

original: こんなにも嬉しいことはないよ。

en.text: What more could I want?

original: 「大好き」って言われると嬉しいね。

en.text: It is nice to hear someone say "I love you".

original: そのニュースはすごく嬉しいよ。

en.text: I'm very glad to hear the news.

original: 私も嬉しいわ。

en.text: I'm happy, too.
I, too, am happy.
I'm happy as well.

original: ありがとう。そう言ってもらえるとすごく嬉しいな。

en.text: Thank you. It makes me really happy to hear that from you.

original: 赤ちゃんの面倒をみれるのが、すごく嬉しい。

en.text: I'm very happy that I can take care of the baby.

original: ご連絡をいただけてとても嬉しいです。

en.text: It's so good to hear from you.

original: 今日はすごく嬉しそうだね。

original: こんなに嬉しいことはないよ。

original: お知り合いになれて、とても嬉しいです。

en.text: Tom and Mary said that they're glad that you're back.
Tom and Mary said they're glad that you're back.

original: 勲さんが来てくれて本当に嬉しいわ。

en.text: It's really nice having you here, Isao.

original: 来てくれて嬉しいよ。

en.text: We're glad you're coming.

original: 「今日ね、嬉しいことがあったの」「何があったの？」「ひみつ」「はっ？聞いて欲しかったんじゃないの？」「そうなんだけどね」

en.text: "Something happy happened today." "What was it?" "It's a secret." "Huh? Didn't you want me to ask you?" "Yeah."

original: 芽衣さんのお墨付きがもらえるなんて、すごく嬉しいです。

en.text: I'm really glad Mei gave me her endorsement.
I'm really happy to receive Mei's endorsement.

original: 子どもたちは嬉しそうだったよ。

en.text: The children looked happy.

original: 個人的に、変更が遅くなると残念だと思うけど、やっと良い方向に少しずつ向かいそうで嬉しいな！

en.text: I personally think it's a shame when change is slow to come, but I'm glad that things finally seem to be gradually heading for the better!

original: 「パパ、お帰りなさい」「ただいま、萌々香。お土産だよ」「パパ、ありがとう。私ね、パパがいない間も、ずっとパパのこと考えてたのよ」「それは、嬉しいな。ありがとう。パパのどんなことを考えてくれてたの？」「えっとね・・・ パパ、どんなお人形さん買ってきてくれるかなぁとか、萌々香の好きなお菓子いっぱい買ってきてくれるかなぁとか・・・お洋服も。わぁ、このクマちゃんのぬいぐるみかわいい。こんなの欲しかったんだ。パパ、大好き」

en.text: "Daddy, welcome back!" "Hey, Momoka! I brought you something." "Thanks, Daddy. I was thinking of you all the time when you weren't here." "That's sweet. Thank you. What things were you thinking about daddy?" "Well, I was thinking of what kind of doll you'd buy me, whether you'd bring me lots of my favorite candy...and clothes. Whoa, this bear plushie is so cute! It's just the one I wanted. I love you, Daddy."

original: 嬉しくないの？

en.text: Aren't you glad?

original: メチャクチャ嬉しんだけど、なんでだろう？

en.text: I'm super-duper happy, but I don't know why.

original: もう９月だ。しかしながら、たいへん嬉しい。

en.text: It's already September; however, it is very hot.

indices: もう 九月{９月} だ 然しながら{しかしながら} 大変{たいへん} 嬉しい

original: 「今度、子供たちに英語を教えることになったんだけど、嬉しい反面、緊張する。上手く喋れるかな」「すごいじゃん。少々失敗しても、ご愛敬ってことで大丈夫よ。自信もって頑張ってね！」

en.text: "So, I'll be teaching the kids English next time, and while I'm really happy, on the other hand, I'm nervous. I wonder if I'll be able to speak it well?" "That's great! Even if you mess up here and there, it'll just be endearing, so it's fine. Be confident, and do your best!"

original: お褒めの言葉をありがとうございます。嬉しかったです。

en.text: Thank you for your words of praise. I was very happy.

original: あなたも来てくれると嬉しんだけど。

en.text: It would be great if you could come, too.

original: 本当は嬉しかったんだ。

en.text: To be honest, I was happy.
I really was happy.

original: マジで嬉しい！

en.text: I'm really happy!
I'm really happy.

original: めっちゃ嬉しいです！

en.text: I'm really happy!

en.text: I'm not happy about this situation.

original: アドバイス頂けたら嬉しいです。

en.text: I'd appreciate some advice.
I'd appreciate it if you could give me some advice.

original: 顔は見えないけど、いてくれるだけで本当に嬉しい。

en.text: I don't know what you look like, but I love that you're there.

original: 遠くに明かりが見えた時は、嬉しかった。

en.text: We were glad when we saw a light in the distance.

original: また声が聞けて嬉しい。

en.text: It's good to hear your voice again.

original: 笑顔が見れて嬉しい。

en.text: It's good to see you smile.

original: トムにまた会えて、めっちゃ嬉しかった。

en.text: I was so happy to see Tom again.
It was great to see Tom again.

original: またトムさんにお会いできて、すごく嬉しかったです。

en.text: I was so happy to see Tom again.
I was very happy to meet Tom again.
It was great to see Tom again.

original: 嬉しい？

en.text: Are you happy?

original: 一見、みんな嬉しそうだったよ。

en.text: Apparently, everyone was happy.
At first glance, everyone seemed happy.

original: ご一緒できて嬉しいです。

en.text: I'm happy to be with you.

original: トムは嬉しそうには見えなかったな。

original: 声が聞けて嬉しいよ。

It's good to hear your voice.

en.text: He said that he wasn't very happy.

original: 本当に嬉しそうね。

en.text: You sound really happy.

original: 彼女は嬉しいです。

en.text: She is happy.

original: 彼は嬉しいです。

en.text: He is happy.

original: 桃子は、おはじきを「一つ、二つ、三つ、四つ、五つ、六つ、七つ、八つ、九つ、十」まで数えると黙り込んでしまいました。お母さんが「十一、十二、十三」と続けると嬉しそうに「十四、十五、十六」と数え続けました。

en.text: Momoko counted the marbles: "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten" and then went silent. When her mother continued with "eleven, twelve, thirteen," she happily picked up with "fourteen, fifteen, sixteen."

original: 昔好きだったゲームのリメイク版が発売されて嬉しい。

en.text: I'm excited that a remake of a game I used to love got released.
